facts.fact: The ATU says its Conference of Plenipotentiaries transferred the chairmanship from Algeria to Nigeria, with Nigeria's communications minister Bosun Tijani assuming it, at the session held in Abuja on 23-24 July 2026.
The ATU lists Nigeria among the 25 member states elected to its Administrative Council for the next four-year period.
The ATU says the session was hosted by the Government of Nigeria in Abuja, and that member states adopted the 2026 Abuja Declaration on Meaningful Connectivity for Africa.
